page_statements: In accordance with applicable law and the NAIC Market Regulation Handbook, Market Conduct Exams may be performed on both domestic and foreign insurance companies at any time to evaluate compliance with state laws and regulations regarding claims handling, underwriting, sales practices, and marketing. Market conduct exams typically take 18 months to complete and final exam reports are posted under the year examined, not the year the report is completed.
